b01_0004.old: 作为穿梭机替代品的巡航扑翼机。它利用清晨收集的太阳能驱动机械核心，通过金属人造肌肉扇动机翼，而非使用化学燃料。机械核心虽然环保，但容易过热且难以冷却，导致巡航距离较短，因发动机过热所需的飞行等待时间通常也比普通穿梭机更长。此外还配备了小型户外化学燃料发电机。

b01_0005.en: A Miho plasma sniper rifle, highly accurate but with a low rate of fire.
b01_0005.old: A medium rifle capable of shooting plasma slugs as hot as the sun. Although usually mounted on Bulgasal tanks this weapon is sometimes used by heavy elite infantry for tactial diversity.\n\nCaliber: plasma cell

b01_0006.en: A build-up tolerance to Solar Juice. The more severe this tolerance is, the more Solar Juice it takes to get the same effect.
b01_0006.old: 对太阳花汤药逐渐产生耐受。耐受程度越高，需要服用更多太阳花汤药才能达到相同的效果。

b01_0007.en: A build-up tolerance to helianto based drugs. The more severe this tolerance is, the more Solar Tea or Solar Pipes it takes to get the same effect.
b01_0007.old: 对基于太阳花的药物逐渐产生耐受。耐受程度越高，需要饮用更多太阳花茶或吸食更多太阳花烟才能达到相同的效果。

b01_0008.en: A chemical addiction to Solar Juice.\nWithout regular doses of Solar Juice the body may experience pain, a lower state of conciusness, impaired movement, reduced sight, low blood pressure and reduced hand-eye coordination.
b01_0008.old: 对太阳花汤药产生化学成瘾。\n若不定时服用太阳花汤药，身体会出现疼痛、意识下降、行动受损、视力下降、血压降低以及手眼协调能力下降等症状。

b01_0033.en: Arkitos Miho can survive in colder regions much easier than other Miho. Thanks to the industrialization of the Northern Hemisphere they developed some toxic resistance. However, because they used more calories to keep their brains warm, they lost a bit of their ability to socialize. That seems very human like.

However, because they used more calories to keep their brains warm, they lost a bit of their ability to socialize. That seems very human like.

b01_0037.en: Artikos Mihos can endure cold climates thanks to Bergmann's rule and their small ears. They also have a toxic resistance due to industrialization in the Northern Hemisphere. However, they slightly diminished social skills, as they use more energy for warmth instead of brain function. Though it is still comparable to average humans.
